name: Sprite Darter
summary: Among Feralas's ancient trees, Sprite Darters flit while the Grimtotem seek to capture them. These rare faerie dragons are revered for their spiritual and magical qualities.

sections.title: Faerie Dragons of the Wild
sections.body: Sprite Darters glide through Feralas's ancient forests on iridescent wings. Shy and peaceful, these elusive woodland beasts draw the attention of those who study Kalimdor's wild places for their natural power and resistance to magic.

sections.title: Grimtotem Captivity
sections.body: The Grimtotem tauren of Feralas have begun rounding up and caging many Sprite Darters, though no one knows why. Kindal Moonweaver, a concerned night elf, seeks allies to break the cages and free the trapped hatchlings before the Grimtotem bend them to their will.

sections.title: Spiritual Interest
sections.body: Sprite Darters also interest those who study primal power. At Camp Mojache, Witch Doctor Uzer'i, a troll spiritualist, studies the natural energies and muisek within them. He seeks their essence to understand the unique magic thriving throughout Feralas.

faq.answer: Sprite Darters are small faerie dragons found in Feralas's wilderness. Their shimmering wings, bond with nature, and elusive magic set them apart.

faq.q: Why are the Grimtotem tauren capturing them?
faq.answer: No one knows why the Grimtotem are capturing Sprite Darters. The clan has been netting and caging many in the woods, perhaps to exploit their rare spiritual and magical qualities.

faq.q: Who is trying to protect the Sprite Darters?
faq.answer: Kindal Moonweaver works to protect Sprite Darters. The elf in Feralas calls on allies to break Grimtotem cages and free the captives.

faq.q: Why is Witch Doctor Uzer'i interested in Sprite Darters?
faq.answer: Witch Doctor Uzer'i seeks the essence, or muisek, of Sprite Darters to learn about Feralas's primal spiritual forces and magical wildlife.

faq.q: Can you raise a Sprite Darter?
aliases: can i get a sprite darter
faq.answer: Those who help Kindal Moonweaver free captive hatchlings and defend their nests may be entrusted with a rare Sprite Darter Egg to rear and protect.
Wild Sprite Darters are generally skittish and passive toward travelers. If threatened or provoked, they defend themselves with bursts of nature magic.

angles.text: As a night elf, you revere faerie dragons as sacred wardens of the forest. Freeing captured Sprite Darters from the Grimtotem is part of caring for the woods.
As an ally of Kindal Moonweaver, you can help free captive hatchlings in Feralas and hinder the hostile Grimtotem tribe.
As a troll spiritualist, you may study spiritual muisek and Feralas's ancient essence, as Witch Doctor Uzer'i does at Camp Mojache.
As a druid, you regard faerie dragons as kin to nature spirits. Their capture by poachers disrupts the forest's balance.
